about_the_game:
Gameplay:

Catch, Kill, Eat – The Ultimate Fishing Challenge!

Dive into fast-paced, arcade-style action as you reel in bigger and better fish! From taking on time-sensitive bounties to hunting legendary fish, the stakes get higher as you prove your fishing skills. The more you fish, the bigger your catch – until you’re battling massive, Kaiyu-sized creatures! Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate fisherman?

Story:

An old monkey fisherman has always wanted a child. One day, after 20 years of searching, he finally catches one while fishing. But all is not well—the baby monkey doesn't like the taste of fruits or nuts, a superstition of misfortune in the monkey village. Can Papa keep the evil spirits of the sea from getting out of hand while also protecting a child the villagers want to punish for an outdated belief?

Features:

• Fast paced fishing

• Outfits Customization for your child

• Collectible Fish Models And Concept Art
